fatal_block_boundary_failure.summary: The extensions recognize the expected number of list and blockquote elements, but Pandoc's lazy list continuation absorbs four source-level outside blocks into the preceding final list item. Counts remain green while parentage and list-item contents are wrong.
fatal_block_boundary_failure.independent_oracle: Source column-zero boundaries were made explicit in memory by inserting blank lines before the no-blank lists, the column-zero blockquote, and the column-zero prose that follows lists; no words or inline markup were changed. Pandoc markdown-smart then supplied the expected hierarchy. Candidate visible prose still matched globally, but ordered list-item text and parentage did not.

mismatches.source_outside_block: The three-line product-check blockquote beginning 'The product check above is this note's own.'
mismatches.candidate_result: The blockquote is a descendant of the fifth Section 1 list item.
mismatches.source_boundary: The blockquote markers begin at column zero after the fifth item's indented continuation lines.

mismatches.source_outside_block: The paragraph beginning 'This fork is real and acknowledged by both sides.'
mismatches.candidate_result: The complete global fork/claim-boundary paragraph is appended inside the Singal bullet.
mismatches.source_boundary: The paragraph begins at column zero after the second Section 2 list item.

mismatches.source_outside_block: The paragraph beginning 'Some simple single-factor explanations are not sufficient...'
mismatches.candidate_result: The complete global caveat paragraph is appended inside ordered item 3 ('Different estimands').
mismatches.source_boundary: The paragraph begins at column zero after ordered item 3's indented continuation lines.

mismatches.source_outside_block: The paragraph beginning 'The two null constructions are different...'
mismatches.candidate_result: The complete no-inference/global-estimand paragraph is appended inside the Mittal bullet.
mismatches.source_boundary: The paragraph begins at column zero after the second kinematic list item's indented continuation lines.

fatal_block_boundary_failure.meaning_risk: The hierarchy falsely scopes global qualifications and conclusions to specific bullets. The fourth mismatch is especially claim-bearing: the no-inference boundary appears as part of the Mittal item rather than the post-list conclusion.

responsive_layout_failure.summary: The stylesheet defines .tablewrap overflow handling, but no .tablewrap element exists. The table is a direct BODY child with min-width 620px and visible overflow.
responsive_layout_failure.mobile_visible_result: The 390px Chrome screenshot visibly clips the right side of the banner, navigation links, title, and opening prose; the page lays out wider than the viewport.

framing_and_nav.footer_preflight_limit: The footer's 14/14 list-item and blockquote-intact counts are true as counts but insufficient and misleading as an equivalence claim because four item contents/parents are wrong.

decision.required_next_gate: A no-overwrite successor must compare complete ordered list-item text and parent hierarchy, not counts; keep all four outside blocks outside their lists; place the table inside the existing .tablewrap overflow container; then repeat per-cell, emphasis, charset, desktop/mobile Chrome and receipt checks.
